---
name: Feature request
description: Suggest a focused improvement with a reproducible use case
labels: [enhancement]
---

## Problem
What concrete problem does this solve? Include one real workflow.

## Proposed behavior
Describe the expected API or semantics, not just an implementation.

## Workarounds / alternatives
What can users do today?

## Compatibility and security
Does this affect previously accepted contracts, error codes, or trust boundaries?

## Acceptance criteria
How would a maintainer verify this works?
